description: Link two tasks together with a plain (non-dependency) relationship, so they reference each other. Use for 'related to' connections that don't imply blocking order. Returns the linked task.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when the task ids are custom task IDs instead of native ClickUp IDs. Requires `team_id`.

links_to.description: ID of the task to link it to.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: add_task_link
